wz.about.text:
- I am a Discord bot written in Python, built specifically for managing WZ registrations.
- My goal is to make registrations easier by providing automated processes, overviews, and workflows.
- I am released under the MIT License, so you can use, modify, and redistribute me for free as long as the original copyright and license notices are kept.
- My GitHub page is public, and everyone is welcome to review the code, report issues, or contribute to the project.
